title: Earnings Conference Calls and the SEC Comment Letter Process
authors: Alina Lerman; Thomas D. Steffen; Kangkang Zhang
eligible_reason: No staggered unit-by-time DiD. Tables 3-6 are comment-letter-level regressions of letter/review characteristics on cccl (letter references the conference call) with year-quarter and SEC office (or firm) FE and determinant controls: cccl is a letter attribute, not a treatment that switches on in a unit panel. The only DiD (Tables 7-8) is a matched-pair stacked design: each CCCL firm is paired with a matched comment-letter firm, regressions of 10-K text and spread/illiquidity on treatxpost + cccl + post + time-varying controls with pair_id and calendar year-quarter FE (sample5.dta: 208 pairs, 369 firms, 44 firms in 2-3 pairs). Stacked-only (pair FE, pair-level post main effect, firms duplicated across pairs) and every column also has time-varying controls, so not an eligible design and not a 5c near-miss.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe. STATA Code.do lines 350-360 (Table 7 Panel B): reghdfe len10k treatxpost cccl post $licontrol, absorb(cyearqtr pair_id) vce(cluster pair_id); $licontrol = roa compound_ret acc log_mve mtb std_abs_ret earnvol num_segments foreign form10k. Table 7 Panel C splits treatxpost by agree/other; Table 8 Panel B spread/illiquidity with $sprdcontrol; Table 8 Panel C splits by management/volume groups. Tables 4-6: reghdfe y cccl $controls, absorb(lyearqtr dcf_office) or absorb(lyearqtr gvkey); comment-level absorb(upup).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Comment-letter dates vary across pairs, but the design is a pair-stacked 2x2 DiD, not a unit-FE staggered panel.

specs.exclusion_reason: Matched-pair stacked DiD (pair_id FE, cccl and post main effects, firms repeated across pairs) plus time-varying controls ($licontrol)
Stacked matched-pair design; treatment split into agree/other interactions; time-varying controls
Stacked matched-pair design with post main effect; time-varying controls ($sprdcontrol incl. lagged price)
Stacked matched-pair design; subgroup-by-treatment interactions; time-varying controls
Letter-level cross-sectional regressions on cccl with office/firm and quarter FE and controls; no staggered treatment

screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). DiD exists only as a pair-stacked matched design with controls; not eligible.
